basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old student from Seattle, currently studying environmental science at university. I love skiing, which is why I'm often on the stevenspass subreddit. I also have a keen interest in public transport, especially trains, which is reflected in my visits to MelbourneTrains. In my free time, I dabble in crafting with my silhouette cutter and enjoy driving my WRX. My typical online hours are late evenings after classes and work. I'm currently single and focusing on my studies and hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of environmental science due to my university studies. Additionally, I've self-taught myself about train systems and car mechanics, which I often explore on related subreddits.
